messages:
mika: ran a 24h validation on Starlane-13b comparing int8 baseline vs int6 tuned. Mixed slices: longform QA, multi-paragraph summarization, short answers. posting compact findings + routing idea.

mika: tl;dr: int6 gives ~18-19% unit-token savings and lower median latency for short calls, but we observe a ~4% drop in longform QA exact-match on multi-span passages. short summaries unaffected.

andre: sample sizes + unit cost math?

mika: 18k samples total (8k longform QA, 6k summarization, 4k shorts). hosted-proxy unit costs: int8 $0.0092/k tok, int6 $0.0075/k tok => ~18.5% savings. p50 latency: int8 470ms -> int6 420ms. p95: int8 1020ms -> int6 1040ms. throughput +9% on ded fleet.

tess: how measured recall? priming sensitivity?

mika: primary metric: span exact-match on L3 longform set. priming sweep 0-5 examples shows int6 degrades more with 4-5 shot templates and concat length >900 tokens. looks like kvcache quant noise under heavy KV windows.

nora: paste the mini-scorecard pls

mika: metric | int8 | int6 | delta
unit_cost($/k) | 0.0092 | 0.0075 | -18.5%
p50_latency(ms) | 470 | 420 | -11%
p95_latency(ms) | 1020 | 1040 | +2%
longform_QA_exact(%) | 81.5 | 77.5 | -4.0pp
throughput(tokens/s) | 2100 | 2290 | +9%
kv_cache_hit(long) | 0.66 | 0.60 | -6pp

andre: 4pp drop is concerning for doc-QA. can we do conservative routing by feature hint and length?

mika: proposal: default route -> int8. allow int6 for short-summary and short-answer when estimated output <250 tokens AND prompt not priming-heavy. two guards: (1) if examples_count >=3 or prompt contains chain-of-thought markers -> force int8; (2) if estimated concat_context >1000 tokens -> force int8. soft canary: start 10% short-summary traffic to int6, monitor 48h.

tess: i'll add automated priming-sensitive snapshot during canary and alert if longform exact-match drop >2% vs baseline.
nora: ops: gfx impact? memory / kvcache eviction concerns?

mika: for Dedicated we can enable slightly larger batch sizes for int6 to amplify cost wins but must watch KV eviction and memory. no infra blocker short-term.

deploy-bot: Canary ticket created: ML-2048-starlane-int6-routing - 4332110200

andre: monitoring plan: 48h canary, track exact-match by slice, rouge/f1 for summarization, CTR, unit cost delta, p95 latency. alert if longform exact-match drops >2%.

mika: product action: add feature_hint in GTN SDK so callers can indicate {"feature":"summary","est_out":200}. will default conservative. product to opt-in for cost-savings.

nora: follow-ups: run A/B on user-visible metrics after 2 weeks, then final recommendation. share failing examples CSV to eng-ml channel.

mika: filing short runbook in #eng-ml and ping me for full dumps.
